rows.en: Brother Jack!! Brother Ace!!
These two are already beaten to a pulp! Here, have some!!
Uwaah!
I'll fix you up just like these two!!
Waaaaah!!
Mebius! Are you all right!?
You can still talk, huh! Keep quiet for a while!!
Gwahh!
Brother Jack!!
What do I do... At this rate, everyone's going to be beaten...
Ultraman Mebius! Have a taste of this!
Mebius! Look out!
Gwahh!
Brother Ace!!
Mebius... don't give up... Remember...
Remember? What are you telling me to remember!?
...You, of all people, should be able to do it...
Brother!! Brotheeeeer!!
So, what'll you do now, Mebius? You're the only one left!!
As for you, we'll take our time tormenting you nice and slowly.
Brother Jack... Brother Ace...
...No matter what the situation!! I'll hold you off right here!
I'll protect the Plasma Spark... I'll protect everyone!!
At that moment, Mebius's feelings called forth a miracle.
The Phoenix Nest appeared before Mebius and the others.
That's... the Phoenix Nest!
I remember now... This is the power of our bonds, "Phoenix Brave"!!
I have... "comrades"... comrades who fight together and support each other...
(That's right... You're not alone!!)
The way I am now... I'm not alone anymore!!
Th-That's impossible!!
Beaten again...!? Waaaaah!!
We did it... We won!!
Brother Jack! Brother Ace! Are you all right!?
Don't worry...
Something like this won't finish us off...
Please don't act tough! Hurry to the base!
We're fine... More importantly, Mebius, you truly did well...
You've grown strong, Mebius...
...Yes!
That's a good answer... Well then, we'll head back to the base...
Completed the quest "The Alien Alliance's Obsession".
You can report quests in the Quest Room at the base.
Enemies reportedly snuck into the Veda Cube we cleared and made it their lair. Please find and defeat them. The control room looks suspicious.
Hey!! What the hell is this room!?
The room was swarming with Imagin and Dopants.
What the hell is goin' on!? Look at all these Imagin!
What!? Look at all these Dopants!
What!? Look at how many there are!
What!? Look at how many there are!

Looks like this is the lair from the request. Still, there are way too many of them.
Well, well, if it isn't the heroes! What're you doing in a place like this?
Don't tell me you came to take us down?
Hey, you...! Arms Dopant!
You...! Arms Dopant!

notes.note: Quest023.bla maps TextIdOffset+N to row N+1 (checked against empty rows 11/14/18/20/24/26/32 and the attack cues). Speakers: Mebius (14) 9,12,15,21,22,28,30,33,36-38,41,58,59,61,66,67,70,73; Alien Nackle (149) 10,13,17,34,63; Alien Guts (130) 23,35,64; Jack (127) 16,19,68,71,74; Ace (126) 25,27,29,31,69,72; narration 39,40.
Nackle taunts while attacking Mebius; 'hora' rendered as the attack taunt 'Here, have some!!'.
Identical Japanese elsewhere in quest output is 'Uwaah!'; reused.
Speaker label is Alien Nackle (149) per script, although the portrait in that slot is Guts; followed by Nackle's attack on Mebius.
Alien Guts, polite-sadistic. Subject unstated (volitional 'agemashou'); rendered 'we' since Guts and Nackle act together.
'Kuitomete misemasu' = hold the enemy back/stop them here; Mebius addresses the two aliens.
Phoenix Nest = GUYS base from Ultraman Mebius (established English name); not in glossary.
Phoenix Brave = Mebius Phoenix Brave (established English name); kept in quotes as the source does. Not in glossary. Rows 42-57 are empty/unused (script jumps +40 to +57).
Speaker is Hikari (CHARA_NAME 35) per script; parenthesised voice kept in parentheses as in source.
Mebius to Jack and Ace: 'tsuyogaranai de' = don't put on a brave face; 'kyoten' = the base, as in the system line.
Event-table copy of the quest description; Veda Cube / lair / control room follow QuestMess#0.75. Wraps to 3 lines; the Japanese is also 3 lines (description window).

Quest024.bla maps +N to row N+1. Speakers: Ankh (36) 3, 21; narration 5; ??? (30) 22-23 = Arms Dopant before reveal; Arms Dopant (184) 39. Leader blocks 6-20 and 24-38 follow Pt_Chara_Check order: Den-O Sword (Momotaros), W (Shotaro), OOO, Black RX, Rider 1, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00. Arms Dopant g=n; no pronouns used.
Source has an apparent kanji typo for 'afureteita' (overflowing); read as 'swarming with'.
Momotaros variant (rough 'nan da tten da ... yo').
Momotaros variant uses rough 'omee'; rendered 'Hey, you...!' to keep his voice, all other identical lines share 'You...! Arms Dopant!'.
Arms Dopant (184, +38). 'Yarare ni kita' = came here to be beaten by us.

report: All 80 rows translated. Speakers from Quest023.bla / Quest024.bla (N+1 mapping). Phoenix Nest and Phoenix Brave not in glossary (established franchise names). Row 0.60 speaker Hikari per script. DG_QUEST024 0.5 has a source typo (read as 'overflowing'). Guts' 'we' in 0.35 inferred.
